summary: Lakefront Biotherapeutics NV filed a Form 6-K on October 15, 2026, announcing the completed sale of its preclinical CAR-T pipeline to Armed Cell Therapeutics BV on October 14, 2026. The terms include an €8 million upfront payment and up to $230 million in milestones plus a low-single-digit royalty. The divestiture follows a strategic review and substantially completes the company's previously announced wind-down of legacy cell therapy activities. No board recommendation or advisor was disclosed. The transaction is cash-and-contingent consideration with no regulatory clock noted. Watch for milestone achievement and use of proceeds toward T-cell engager programs.
